job.job_title: EY - GDS Consulting - AIA - Agentic AI Engineer - Senior
job.job_description:
At EY, were all in to shape your future with confidence.

Well help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.

Join EY and help to build a better working world.

Career Family: AIA Agentic AI ENGINEER

The opportunity

We are seeking a dynamic Senior consultant to join our AI & Data Consulting team, focused on driving data-driven transformations. The ideal candidate will bring a unique blend of AI strategy consulting, data & enterprise data assessments and hands-on collaboration with cross-functional teams to deliver scalable and impactful solutions.

You will work closely with C-suite leaders, operating partners, and portfolio company executives to help them leverage Agentic AI, analytics, and data-driven platforms to unlock value, accelerate digital transformation, and create competitive advantage.

Your key responsibilities

Technical Excellence:
AI & Data Consulting for Private Equity
Partner with Operating Partners and leadership teams to define and execute Agentic AI, GenAI, and analytics-driven strategies.
Develop and deploy AI implementation playbooks, frameworks, and accelerators that drive tangible value creation.
Assess technology cost optimization, data monetization, and digital transformation opportunities across portfolio companies.
AIReady Data & Enterprise Data Assessments
Assess whether data is clean, secure, wellstructured, and ready for AI i.e.: AI-readiness evaluation (quality, lineage, security, architecture)
Review existing enterprise data to identify gaps and issues and evaluate the strength of data foundations across ERP and core systems
Define clear, prioritized actions to fix gaps and enable AI use cases
Apply assessments during diligence, postmerger integration, and 100day plans
AI & Digital Transformation
Design Agentic driven initiatives, translating business and functional requirements into agent architectures, workflows, and capabilities
Build proprietary AI/ML accelerators to enhance business processes such as customer care, software development, predictive analytics, and operational automation.
Stay ahead of emerging trends in AI, LLMs, process mining, and advanced analytics to deliver cutting-edge solutions.
Familiarity with process mining tools like Celonis, Signavio, or PAFnow.
Proficiency with Agentic AI frameworks (e.g., LangChain, semantic kernels, Autogen)
Proficiency in Python and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG)
Understanding of basic data structures and algorithms
Working knowledge of: REST APIs, JSON,Async workflows
Data & Analytics Strategy
Design and implement data solutions leveraging cloud platforms, data engineering frameworks, and predictive analytics models to solve complex business challenges.
Develop and Deploy data governance and quality frameworks, data marketplaces and analytics dashboards.
Expertise in designing, implementing, and maintaining Master Data Management (MDM) solutions to ensure data consistency, accuracy, and governance across enterprise systems.
Strong understanding of Cloud platforms (Azure / AWS / GCP), data visualization tools, and analytics solutions.
Exposure to ERP transformations (e.g., Dynamics 365, SAP, Oracle) and portfolio tech integrations is a plus.
Team Leadership & Collaboration
Work with cross-functional teams across consulting, product development, and data engineering to refine requirements
Foster collaboration between AI product teams, analytics experts, and sector specialists to deliver integrated solutions.
Drive knowledge sharing and capability-building within the team.
Provide technical expertise during strategy execution, POCs, and architectural decisions

Skills and Attributes:

Educational Background

MBA / PGDM / masters degree in data science, AI, Analytics, or Business Management. Engineering or quantitative background preferred.

Professional Experience

5 to 10 years of experience in Agentic AI, digital transformation, and strategy consulting .
Proven track record in AI-driven transformation programs, including Agentic AI, predictive analytics, and process mining.
Experience in building and deploying accelerators, playbooks, or proprietary platforms for data-driven consulting.

Soft Skills

Exceptional client engagement and stakeholder management skills
Strong problemsolving skills with the ability to translate complex business requirements into practical, highquality technical solutions.
Excellent communication, presentation, and leadership abilities.

Preferred Certifications

GenAI and LLM focussed, AI/ML, or data analytics certifications (Google, Microsoft, AWS, Coursera, etc.)

Why Join Us

Be at the forefront of AI-driven innovation across multiple client sectors.
Work with global clients to drive real business impact.
Collaborate with a team of AI experts, analytics leaders, and industry specialists in a highly entrepreneurial environment.

What we offer

EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. Well introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.

Continuous learning: Youll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
Success as defined by you: Well provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
Transformative leadership: Well give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
Diverse and inclusive culture: Youll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.
